title: Hybrid Retrieval: Fuse, Don't Choose
objective: After this lesson you will be able to combine lexical and vector retrieval with staged funnels and RRF-style score fusion, measure each stage's contribution, and decide per-query routing vs fusion.
why: Lexical wins SKUs and names; vectors win paraphrase — production queries mix both ('SH-1-v9 return window' has exact tokens AND intent). Single-mode retrieval fails half the catalog by construction. Hybrid strategies (staged funnels, score fusion, per-query routing) cover both miss profiles, and measuring stage contributions tells you which half earns its cost.

blocks.text: Staged funnels: cheap recall, precise top

The standard production shape: **cheap first-stage** retrieval (TF-IDF/BM25 + vector, top-200 each) → **union + dedupe** → **rerank top-50** (Ch.6) → **generate from top-5**. Cost tiers match stages: pennies for recall, dimes for rerank, dollars for generation context. Each stage's contribution is measurable: ablate it (remove → re-score gold) and keep only stages that earn their latency.

blocks.caption: RRF fuses rank positions: no cross-system score normalization required

blocks.text: **Reciprocal Rank Fusion** (`1/(k+rank)`, k=60 standard) sums per-system rank scores: a chunk ranked #1 lexically and #3 by vector outscores also-rans everywhere. Its superpower is avoiding score calibration (TF-IDF's 0..1 and cosine's −1..1 never mix directly). Consensus across retrievers also signals confidence — agreed top ranks are rarely wrong.

Alternative: **route** (SKU pattern → lexical; paraphrase → vector; mixed → fuse). Routing saves the unused retriever's cost but adds a classifier to maintain and misroute. Default to always-fuse (simpler, robust); route only when one retriever's cost dominates AND query intent classifies cleanly (SKU regexes classify perfectly — the rare free lunch).

blocks.title: Fuse the rankings
blocks.note: Run it: consensus items (p1, p3) float above single-system picks (p2, p4) — agreement outranks loners. Union size 4 shows recall breadth preserved: fusion reorders, never drops.

items: Funnel: cheap union recall → rerank → minimal generation context, cost-tiered per stage
RRF fuses ranks without score calibration; consensus signals confidence
Always-fuse by default; route only on clean classifiers (SKU regex) with dominant cost savings

exercise.prompt: (a) Run the practice fusion and explain why p2/p4 sink below consensus picks. (b) Add a third retriever list ['p4-paraphrase','p2','p5'] and re-run: state the new order and why the consensus pair still holds top-2. (c) State when you would switch this corpus to per-query routing, with the cost condition.
hints: Consensus math: p1 gets 1/61+1/62, p3 gets 1/61+1/62... compute both; loners get single terms. Agreement compounds.
Third list boosts p4 (two votes now) — watch it climb past p2 to #3 while the consensus pair (p3, p1) holds top-2: agreement resists single-list boosts. p5 enters (union size 5).
Routing wins when: one retriever dominates cost AND intent classifies cleanly (SKU regex → lexical-only saves the vector call per SKU query).
exercise.why: Vote-count intuition (agreement compounds) plus the routing-vs-fusion cost analysis are the two hybrid judgments — each computed, not asserted.
exercise.code: // Fusion-probe pattern: add a retriever list, watch rank deltas.

quiz.q: Why RRF over direct score averaging?
options: Rank-only fusion needs no cross-system calibration (TF-IDF 0..1 vs cosine −1..1 never mix directly)
quiz.explain: Incommensurable scales break averaging; ranks are universal. RRF's k=60 dampens top-heavy dominance sanely.

quiz.q: SKU-heavy query load, vector calls dominate cost. Move?
options: Route: SKU-regex queries go lexical-only (clean classifier + dominant cost = the rare justified routing)
quiz.explain: Routing's two preconditions met: classifies perfectly (regex), saves the dominant cost. Otherwise always-fuse.

quiz.q: New reranker added to the funnel. Proof it earns its latency?
options: Ablate: remove it, re-score gold hit-rate — keep only measured contributors
quiz.explain: Stage contributions are measured by ablation on gold sets. Unmeasured stages accumulate latency without accountability.

summary: Union recall, RRF fusion, rerank, minimal context — cost-tiered, ablation-justified. Fuse by default; route on clean classifiers with dominant savings.
next: Fused retrieval finds candidates — but vague shopper queries fail before retrieval starts. Next: rewriting intent into retrievable form.
